Every record is environment='canonical-timing' — a MEASURED wall-clock value from an envelope that self-declares `"canonical": true` (the dedicated quiet-EC2 protocol), whose result count is verified against the suite's committed bench/<suite>/expected-rows.tsv (loaded independently of the envelope, which cannot bless its own counts). Work-box timings are NON-CANONICAL and cannot enter this file. Papers may render these ONLY through headline_timing() / timing_provenance() in site/papers/_lib/timing.typ, which always print the provenance alongside the number — enforced at build time by site/scripts/timing-source-gate.mjs. `skipped` is the honest record of which envelopes were left out and why.
